content.hook_text: A prayer for when you're exhausted.
content.subtext: Not just tired. The kind of tired sleep doesn't fix.
content.prayer: Lord, I'm running on fumes and pretending I'm fine. I've said 'I'm just tired' so many times it doesn't mean anything anymore. But You see past the performance. You know the difference between tired and empty. So I'm not going to pray for more energy. I'm praying for the courage to stop. To rest without guilt. To believe that the world keeps turning when I sit down. Fill the empty spaces—not so I can produce more, but so I can actually be present. Teach me that rest is not laziness; it's trust. Amen.
